A letter for Boo

Read this slowly, okay? This one is really for you.

♡   ♡   ♡

Happy 2nd Anniversary, Boo

Hi, Boo. 🤎

Happy two years to us, sayang. Sometimes aku masih suka nggak nyangka kalau kita yang awalnya cuma kenal karena satu organisasi paskib, sekarang udah sampai di titik ini. Dulu kamu yang mulai deketin aku, kita PDKT sekitar satu bulan, and somehow, on October 10th, 2024, you became someone so important in my life.

Thank you for staying, for listening to all my stories and complaints, bahkan cerita-cerita kecil yang mungkin nggak penting buat orang lain. Makasih karena kamu mau sabar ngadepin aku, termasuk saat aku lagi banyak maunya atau mood-ku nggak jelas. You make me feel heard, cared for, and less alone. Aku bersyukur banget punya kamu as my person, my safe place to tell things I can’t always explain to everyone.

Aku tahu kamu kadang nyebelin, suka jailin aku, dan kadang lebih asyik main sama teman-temanmu daripada sama aku. 😒 But, you know what? Itu juga bagian dari kamu yang sering bikin aku ketawa sekaligus gemes sendiri. Aku suka caramu jadi diri sendiri, caramu manja ke aku, dan caramu bikin aku merasa kalau perhatianmu itu tulus. Aku juga menghargai kamu yang tahu batasan dan bikin aku merasa aman dalam hubungan ini.

Our story may not always be simple. We have our differences, including our beliefs, and I know that love also means learning to understand each other with respect. Aku nggak minta kita jadi dua orang yang selalu sama atau selalu sempurna. I just hope we can keep being honest, patient, and kind to each other, while still respecting who we are.

Thank you for being part of my days, for every laugh, every little memory, every silly picture, and every moment that has become special just because you were there. Kalau suatu hari nanti kita lagi capek, lagi sibuk, atau lagi nggak sependapat, I hope we remember that we’re on the same team. Let’s keep learning how to love each other better, one day at a time.

For our second anniversary, I don’t need everything to be perfect. I’m just happy that we’ve made it this far and that I get to celebrate these two years with you. Semoga ke depannya kita bisa punya lebih banyak cerita, lebih banyak tawa, lebih banyak hal sederhana yang nanti bakal kita kenang sambil bilang, “ingat nggak dulu kita pernah…?”

And Boo, please remember this: you are appreciated more than you probably realize. Aku bersyukur bisa kenal kamu, bersyukur atas waktu yang udah kita lewati, dan bersyukur untuk hal-hal baik yang kita pelajari selama bersama. Whatever the future looks like, I’ll always be grateful that our paths crossed and that I got to share this chapter of my life with you.

I love you, Boo. More than these little words can ever explain. ♡

With all my love,
your girl 🤍
